Job Description
Software Development Engineer, SA
Who We Are Looking For
We are looking for a motivated Full Stack Software Engineer to join the IS Tech APAC team.
The role provides opportunities to develop and support enterprise applications. We are looking for recent graduates with a solid software engineering foundation, strong interest in full-stack development, and enthusiasm for applying Cloud, AI, and modern engineering technologies to real-world solutions.
What You Will Do
Develop and enhance enterprise applications using Java, Spring / Spring Boot, Oracle, SQL, and REST APIs.
Develop backend services and business logic for transaction processing, data validation, reconciliation, and workflow automation.
Develop and maintain web applications using modern frontend technologies such as React and JavaScript / TypeScript.
Build and support applications running on public cloud platforms such as AWS.
Participate in the full software development lifecycle, including design, development, testing, deployment, and production support.
Apply engineering practices including unit testing, TDD, Git, CI/CD, and code reviews.
Explore and apply Generative AI and AI-assisted development to improve engineering productivity and application capabilities.
Collaborate with business analysts, product owners, and engineering teams to deliver reliable and scalable solutions.
What We Value
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Solid programming fundamentals with attention to code quality.
A proactive learner with good communication and collaboration skills.
Interest in Cloud, AI, and modern software engineering.
Curiosity and willingness to learn and adopt emerging technologies.
Basic Qualifications
Education & Qualifications / Skills
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related discipline.
Good knowledge of Java, object-oriented programming, and Spring / Spring Boot.
Good understanding of Oracle, SQL, and relational databases.
Understanding of REST APIs and web application architecture.
Basic knowledge of React and JavaScript / TypeScript.
Basic understanding of AWS or other public cloud platforms, including common cloud concepts and services.
Familiarity with Git, unit testing, CI/CD, and Agile development.
Basic understanding of Generative AI, LLMs, and AI-assisted software development.
Good written and spoken English.
Preferred Qualifications
Hands-on experience with AWS, cloud-native development, or application deployment on public cloud.
Exposure to MQ / Kafka, Docker, Kubernetes, or microservices.
Experience Using GitHub Copilot Or Other AI-assisted Development Tools.
Understanding or hands-on experience with AI Agents, AI Skills, MCP (Model Context Protocol), prompt engineering, or LLM integration.
Relevant personal projects, hackathons, internships, or academic projects involving Full Stack, Cloud, or AI development.

jobs.title: Business System Analyst, AVP
jobs.descriptionText:
Who We Are Looking For
We are seeking a client- and user-facing Business Systems Analyst who thrives in a collaborative environment and enjoys solving complex business challenges through technology.
The ideal candidate will partner with business stakeholders and development teams to analyze requirements, shape solutions, and support delivery across the full software development lifecycle. Success in this role requires strong financial services knowledge, analytical thinking, communication skills, stakeholder management, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a global environment.
Based in Hangzhou, China, this role provides the opportunity to work with global clients and stakeholders across a wide range of business and technology initiatives.
Why this role is important to us
The team you will be joining is a Business Analysis group within State Street Global Technology Services (GTS). GTS is a key enabler of State Street’s business strategy, delivering technology solutions and insights that support our business lines and clients globally.
Working across business, operations, and technology teams, the group drives strategic initiatives, platform enhancements, process optimization, and technology transformation.
As a Business Systems Analyst, you will serve as a key link between business stakeholders and technology teams, translating business needs into scalable solutions and ensuring successful delivery throughout the project lifecycle. This role offers broad exposure to financial services, business operations, and enterprise technology, while providing opportunities to make a meaningful impact across global initiatives.
Join us if making your mark in the financial services industry from day one is a challenge you are ready to take on.
What You Will Be Responsible For
As a Business Systems Analyst, Assistant Vice President, you will:
Partner with external clients and internal business users to understand business objectives, challenges, and user needs.
Lead the analysis of complex business workflows, data flows, operating models, system interactions, and end-to-end business scenarios.
Evaluate existing processes and systems, identify gaps and improvement opportunities, and help define practical and scalable future-state solutions.
Translate business needs into clear, complete, and actionable requirements for technology teams.
Produce and maintain high-quality business analysis artifacts, including business and functional requirements, process flows, user stories, acceptance criteria, wireframes, data mappings, traceability documentation, and user guides.
Facilitate requirement-gathering workshops, solution discussions, walkthroughs, and stakeholder review sessions.
Work closely with development, architecture, testing, operations, and production support teams throughout the software development lifecycle.
Participate in Agile delivery teams as a Business Analyst or Product Owner, depending on project needs.
Support solution validation, testing, implementation, user readiness, and post-production activities to ensure delivered solutions meet agreed business requirements.
Identify, assess, resolve, or escalate risks, issues, dependencies, and requirement gaps throughout the delivery lifecycle.
Communicate project status, decisions, risks, and required actions clearly to business and technology stakeholders.
Build and maintain strong working relationships with global business and technology partners by communicating effectively in both business and technical language.
Manage multiple priorities and provide business analysis leadership across concurrent initiatives.
Contribute to the development and continuous improvement of business analysis standards, practices, templates, and governance.
Coach and mentor junior Business Analysts, provide guidance and quality reviews, and act as a role model for the wider team.
What We Value
These skills will help you succeed in this role
Strong ownership and the ability to drive work forward with minimal supervision.
Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, with strong interpersonal and stakeholder management capabilities.
Solid understanding of how technology, data, and operational processes work together to support business and client outcomes.
Ability to understand complex business problems and translate them into clear requirements and practical solution options.
Good understanding of financial products, financial services operations, or related business processes.
Strong organizational, prioritization, and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams.
Ability to lead discussions, facilitate workshops, influence decisions, and build alignment across business and technology teams.
Detail-oriented, quality-focused, and committed to producing accurate and consistent deliverables.
Experience working in Agile, Scrum, Waterfall, or hybrid delivery environments.
Education & Preferred Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree or above in Finance, Information Technology, Computer Science, Business, or a related discipline.
6+ years of experience as a Business Analyst, Business Systems Analyst, Product Owner, or in a similar role within financial services, software development, data, or technology delivery.
Demonstrated experience leading business analysis activities for complex, cross-functional, or global initiatives.
Experience working directly with business users, clients, technology teams, and senior stakeholders.
Experience producing functional requirements, process models, user stories, acceptance criteria, data mappings, and other business analysis deliverables.
Experience in any of the following areas is highly desirable:
Financial products, investment servicing, asset management, banking, or capital markets.
Agile delivery tools and practices, such as Jira, backlog management, sprint planning, and story refinement.
CFA qualification or successful completion of the CFA Level I examination.
Additional Requirements
N.A
About State Street
What we do.
State Street is one of the largest custodian banks, asset managers and asset intelligence companies in the world. From technology to product innovation we’re making our mark on the financial services industry. For more than two centuries, we’ve been helping our clients safeguard and steward the investments of millions of people. We provide investment servicing, data & analytics, investment research & trading and investment management to institutional clients.
Work, Live and Grow.
We make all efforts to create a great work environment. Our benefits packages are competitive and comprehensive. Details vary in locations, but you may expect generous medical care, insurance and savings plans among other perks. You’ll have access to flexible Work Program to help you match your needs. And our wealth of development programs and educational support will help you reach your full potential.
Inclusion, Diversity and Social Responsibility.
We truly believe our employees’ diverse backgrounds, experiences and perspective are a powerful contributor to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive and reach their maximum potential while adding value to both our organization and our clients. Role purpose
You'll build and run the CI/CD pipelines which build state of the art application platforms and deploy AWS infrastructure for a multi-year programme moving a large portfolio of middle-office applications to AWS. This is a
hands-on engineering role
: most of your day is spent writing pipeline code, Terraform and scripts, and fixing builds and deployments. You'll work closely with full-stack application teams (ReactJS and Java), database engineers and SRE.

Build tooling
Set up and maintain front-end builds with npm and pnpm, vite, babel etc including workspaces/monorepos, dependency caching, lockfile management and private registries.
Set up and maintain Java builds with Maven and Gradle, including multi-module projects, dependency management and build performance.
Publish and version artifacts through Artifactory (or similar), and keep builds reproducible.
CI/CD pipelines
Design and build pipelines in Harness and GitHub Actions for build, test, security scanning and deployment across all environments.
Create reusable pipeline templates so application teams can onboard quickly and consistently.
Add quality and security gates: unit tests, code coverage, SAST/SCA scanning, container image scanning and approval steps.
Support blue/green and canary deployments, automated rollback and release tracking that meets State Street change management requirements.
Infrastructure as code and AWS
Write and maintain Terraform modules for AWS: VPC, IAM, EC2, ECS/EKS, ALB, S3, RDS and related services.
Manage Terraform state, module versioning and policy checks; detect and fix configuration drift.
Build and run container platforms (Docker, ECS/EKS) for application workloads.
Integrate secrets management (HashiCorp Vault/CyberArk) into pipelines and runtime environments.
Linux
Build, harden and automate Linux servers and container images for applications moving off Solaris and Windows.
Write Shell and Python scripts for automation, troubleshooting and operational tasks.
Support migration of batch jobs and file transfers to the target platform (e.g. AutoSys, MFX/SFTP).
Reliability and collaboration
Work with SRE to add logging, metrics and alerting (e.g. Dynatrace, Splunk) to pipelines and environments.
Troubleshoot build, deployment and environment issues for application teams.
Document runbooks and standards, and use AI assistants (e.g. GitHub Copilot) to speed up pipeline, Terraform and script development, with review.
Required Experience And Skills
5+ years in DevOps, build or platform engineering roles.
Front-end builds: practical experience with npm and pnpm for React/TypeScript projects.
Java builds: strong experience with Maven and Gradle.
Terraform: writing production modules and managing state for AWS.
AWS: hands-on experience with core compute, networking, IAM, containers and managed services.
CI/CD: building pipelines in Harness and/or GitHub Actions; Jenkins experience is a plus.
Linux: strong administration, hardening and scripting (Bash, Python).
Docker and Kubernetes/ECS/EKS.
Git, branching strategies and pull-request workflows.
Preferred
Experience in a regulated financial services environment.
Experience with secrets management (Vault, CyberArk) and security scanning tools (e.g. SonarQube, Black Duck, Checkmarx).
Experience with database change pipelines (Liquibase/Flyway).
AWS certification (DevOps Engineer or SysOps Administrator) and/or HashiCorp Terraform certification.
Success measures (first 12 months)
Reusable pipeline templates adopted by all modernization and migration teams.
All target environments provisioned through Terraform, with no manual infrastructure changes.

Job Description
A highly experienced, hands-on technology leader to serve as Principal Agentic AI Engineer. This role will report to the AI Platform leadership team and will define the target-state Agentic AI platform architecture, establish engineering standards, and guide the delivery and adoption of strategic agentic AI solutions across the organization.
Why this role is important to us
Agentic AI is transforming how organizations automate knowledge-intensive work, accelerate decision-making, and unlock value from enterprise data. Realizing this opportunity at scale requires a secure, governed, and reusable platform that enables engineering and business teams to build production-ready AI solutions. The Principal Agentic AI Engineer will shape this platform, set its technical direction, and ensure that it supports investment performance, investment research, data operations, and related daily operations.
What You Will Be Responsible For
In this role, you will:
Define and own the end-to-end target-state architecture for the Agentic AI platform, including prompt engineering, agent orchestration, memory, tool integration, knowledge management, multi-agent collaboration, and human-in-the-loop patterns.
Lead the design and implementation of strategic, production-grade agentic AI solutions for investment performance, investment research, data operations, and related business workflows.
Establish architectural principles, engineering standards, reusable patterns, and guardrails for agentic AI development and adoption.
Define architectural standards for an Iceberg-based Lakehouse, including table design, partitioning, schema evolution, metadata, performance, and lifecycle management.
Design enterprise knowledge capabilities using retrieval-augmented generation, vector search, knowledge graphs, ontologies, metadata, and semantic retrieval.
Review platform, data, and solution designs to ensure alignment with architectural principles, performance expectations, security requirements, and enterprise standards.
Partner with Platform Engineering to align infrastructure, identity and access management, security, observability, CI/CD, AgentOps, and LLMOps capabilities with architectural intent.
Work with Enterprise Architecture, Governance, Risk, and Security teams to meet access-control, Responsible AI, compliance, and audit requirements.
Publish and maintain reference architectures, design guidelines, engineering patterns, and architectural decision records.
Identify architectural risks, technical debt, and improvement opportunities, and guide the evolution of the platform over time.
Mentor senior engineers and influence technical direction across multiple engineering and application teams.
What We Value
These skills will help you succeed in this role
Strong strategic and systems-thinking skills, with sound judgment across innovation, scalability, reliability, cost, security, and governance.
Ability to translate business objectives into practical platform capabilities and executable technical roadmaps.
Ability to influence engineering teams, architects, governance functions, and senior stakeholders without relying solely on formal authority.
Clear and effective communication, including the ability to explain complex AI and data concepts to technical and non-technical audiences.
A hands-on, delivery-oriented mindset with strong ownership, curiosity, and commitment to engineering quality.
Education & Preferred Qualifications
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Software Engineering, Data Engineering, or a related discipline.
10+ years of experience in software engineering, platform engineering, data engineering, solution architecture, or related technology roles.
Proven experience owning or leading enterprise-scale Agentic AI or Generative AI architecture and delivery.
Deep knowledge of agent orchestration, planning, memory, tool calling, evaluation, guardrails, multi-agent systems, and human-in-the-loop design.
Hands-on experience with agent frameworks such as LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, Semantic Kernel, Google ADK, or comparable technologies.
Strong experience with Python, APIs, microservices, distributed systems, event-driven design, and cloud-native engineering.

About The Private Markets Fund Of Funds Team
The Private Markets Fund of Funds (FoF) team supports the accounting and administration of investment structures that invest across underlying private market funds and, where applicable, co-investments. The team supports a broad range of private market strategies and structures, delivering accurate accounting records, Net Asset Value (NAV) production, investor reporting, and other client-specific deliverables. Responsibilities include, but are not limited to, the processing and reporting of capital calls, distributions, cash transactions, management fees, carried interest, expenses, reconciliations, and NAV-related activities. Team members work within established client requirements, operating procedures, and control frameworks to maintain complete and accurate accounting records and support timely reporting.
Who We Are Looking For
The Associate 2, Private Markets Fund of Funds Fund Accountant performs day-to-day accounting and administration activities for private equity FoF and related investment structures. The role processes fund- and investment-level transactions, performs reconciliations, supports NAV production and investor reporting, investigates routine exceptions, and contributes to the initial review of assigned work. The successful candidate will apply established procedures and controls, manage recurring deliverables with increasing independence, and escalate material issues appropriately while maintaining accuracy and quality.
Why This Role Is Important to Us
The team you will join is part of Alternative Investment Solutions (AIS), a recognized industry-leading provider of fund accounting, fund administration, and risk services to private equity, private credit, real estate, hedge fund, and other alternative investment clients. Our services are fully integrated to provide comprehensive end-to-end solutions across front-, middle-, and back-office operations.
Join us if you are ready to deepen your knowledge of alternative investments, take greater ownership of recurring fund accounting activities, and contribute to high-quality client service.
What You Will Be Responsible For
As an Associate 2, Private Markets FoF Fund Accountant, you will:
Process day-to-day accounting activities, including capital calls, distributions, management fees, carried interest, income and expenses, cash payments etc. using appropriate supporting documentation, client instructions, and established operating procedures.
Investigate reconciling items, accounting breaks, and exceptions; coordinate timely resolution and escalate material issues or risks to reviewers and managers.
Assist with accurate and timely preparation or initial review of Net Asset Value (NAV) calculations and other client deliverables, including supporting schedules and reasonableness checks.
Maintain complete and accurate accounting records, workpapers, and supporting documentation in accordance with client requirements, internal controls, and operating procedures.
Perform assigned quality checks, identify recurring errors or process gaps, and raise observations to the appropriate reviewer or manager.
Coordinate routine information requests with internal teams and service partners and follow through on outstanding items.
Organize assigned priorities, monitor recurring deadlines, and communicate potential delays or dependencies promptly.
Provide day-to-day guidance to less experienced team members on established procedures, where assigned, while escalating technical or judgmental matters.
Complete required training within deadlines and apply the knowledge gained to assigned responsibilities.
What We Value
Strong attention to detail and a consistent commitment to accuracy and quality.
Analytical thinking and practical problem-solving skills.
Ownership and accountability for assigned responsibilities and deliverables.
Clear written and verbal communication and effective teamwork.
Ability to follow established procedures, apply controls consistently, and recognize when escalation is required.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and recurring deadlines with appropriate supervision.
Willingness to build deeper knowledge of private market, alternative investment products and fund accounting.
Openness to feedback. Commitment to continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, high-quality client service.
Key Skills
Working knowledge of accounting principles, including debits and credits, journal entries, account balances, and financial statement concepts.
Ability to process and reconcile cash, investment, partner capital, and commitment activity accurately.
Ability to review source documentation, prepare clear workpapers, and perform basic reasonableness and completeness checks.
Ability to investigate routine breaks and exceptions, document findings, and escalate unresolved or material matters.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel for organizing data, applying standard formulas, reconciling balances, and supporting analysis.
Effective communication with reviewers, managers, internal teams, and service partners.
Strong organization, follow-through, and time management in a deadline-driven environment.
Ability to explain established processes to less-experienced colleagues when requested.
Education And Preferred Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in accounting, finance, business, or a related field.
A minimum of one year of experience in financial services, fund accounting, investment operations, or a related field is preferred.
Experience or knowledge of private markets, fund-of-funds structures, alternative investments or Investment accounting concept is an advantage.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel.
Effective written and verbal communication skills.
Strong organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet reporting deadlines.
Demonstrated willingness to continue developing technical knowledge and assuming greater ownership of assigned deliverables.

Job Description
Who we are looking for:
Responsible for the end-to-end preparation, analysis, and delivery of periodic (quarterly, semi-annual, annual and ad hoc) financial statements and related disclosures in accordance with IFRS, US GAAP, regulatory requirements, and client-specific reporting standards for alternative investment funds and registered funds, including Hedge, Private Equity, Fund-of-Funds, and other investment structures.
Why This Role Is Important To Us
The team you will be joining is part of State Street Global Delivery (SSGD). SSGD gives asset owners and managers access to the essential financial tools they need to deliver effective investment solutions. From core custody, accounting, fund administration and shareholder recordkeeping to complete operations solutions and servicing for alternative assets like OTC derivatives, private equity and real estate, SSGD’s tools help our clients make better investment choices and act on growth opportunities.
Join us if making your mark in the financial services industry from day one is a challenge you are up for.
What You Will Be Responsible For
As
Financial Reporting, Associate 1,
you will:
Set up and maintain reporting folders within shared drives and related reporting platforms for each fund throughout the reporting cycle, ensuring all supporting documentation for financial statement disclosures is obtained, validated, and properly organized. Research and resolve outstanding issues as required, and maintain accurate, complete, and well-structured records to support reporting, review, and audit requirements.
Prepare periodic financial statements:
Perform planning and readiness assessments prior to each reporting cycle to identify potential issues and collaborate with applicable parties to resolve.
Conduct detailed reviews of general ledger balances, identify exceptions or discrepancies, and drive issue resolution with internal applicable parties.
Analyze and validate financial statement balances and disclosures to ensure accuracy, completeness, and overall reasonableness.
Draft financial statements disclosures in compliance with applicable accounting standards, including IFRS and US GAAP requirements.
Adhere to established financial reporting procedures, complete all required task lists, and obtain appropriate sign-offs in accordance with internal policies.
Identify opportunities for process improvement and recommend or implement technical initiatives to reporting procedures, controls, and workflows.
Ensure adherence to the financial statements production calendar.
Coordinate distribution of financial statements:
Assemble financial statements draft, all supporting documentation and calculations.
Managing the receipt of comments on financial statements drafts from external (and internal) parties. Ensure the timely research, resolution, and processing of comments.
Participating in the testing and implementation of financial reporting systems, platforms, and templates, while identifying opportunities to improve efficiency, controls, and automation.
What We Value
These skills will help you succeed in this role
Strong critical thinking, problem-solving, and decision-making skills, with the ability to identify issues, evaluate risks, and deliver effective solutions in a fast-paced environment.
Education & Preferred Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree or above in Accounting, Finance, or related discipline.
Progress toward, or possession of, a recognized professional accounting qualification (e.g., CFA, CPA, ACCA, CA) is an asset.
Knowledge of preparation of financial statements (IFRS and US GAAP) is an asset.
Proficient in Microsoft Office applications, with advanced skills in Excel, including complex formulas, data validation, pivot tables, and financial reporting tools.
Effective English listening and written communication skills.
Superior attention to detail, time management, and organizational skills.
Ability to effectively work under pressure, meet tight deadlines, and deliver high-quality results.

Overtime may be required
Ability to work across time zones when required
Flexibility during peak reporting periods

Join State Street Markets as the
Head of Markets Client Engagement, APAC, Managing Director

As a senior regional representative of the Markets franchise, you will connect client needs with the full breadth of State Street capabilities, coordinate the right product and relationship teams around priority opportunities, and ensure strategic engagement results in clear follow-through and measurable commercial outcomes.
The ideal candidate combines deep capital markets expertise with strong commercial judgment, executive presence, and the ability to mobilize teams across a complex global organization. You should be equally comfortable engaging senior clients, shaping account-level priorities, navigating regional nuances, and driving disciplined execution across multiple products and stakeholders.
This position will report directly to the Head of Markets Commercial & Client Strategy.
Why this role is important to us
The team you will be joining is part of State Street Markets. As a leading provider of trading and lending solutions to the world's institutional investors, we deliver innovative platforms, financing, liquidity, and execution solutions supported by differentiated research, data, and market intelligence.
We are strengthening how Markets engages clients across products, regions, and the broader State Street franchise. APAC represents a strategically important region with diverse client segments, market structures, and growth opportunities. Realizing that opportunity requires a coordinated approach that moves beyond individual product conversations and presents Markets as a connected set of capabilities aligned to each client's business priorities.
This role will be responsible for establishing the Commercial & Client Strategy framework in APAC and embedding a consistent, commercially rigorous model for client prioritization, engagement, and follow-through. The successful candidate will help convert senior dialogue and strategic access into actionable opportunities, strengthen connectivity across Markets and the broader firm, and build a more visible and accountable pipeline of relationship growth.
Join us if making your mark in the capital markets industry from day one is a challenge you are up for.
What You Will Be Responsible For
As the
Head of Markets Client Engagement, APAC, Managing Director
, you will:
Lead commercialization efforts and drive measurable growth with new and existing clients across Markets offerings, by establishing the CCS framework in the region
Maximize the commercial impact of client-facing engagements, curating target client audiences in the region to optimize commercial impact, and converting strategic client engagement into measurable ROI and relationship growth
Be the Markets central point of contact for a subset of top-tier client relationships in the region, both internally and externally
Execute Markets-wide targeted client strategies in concert with Markets Sales leadership, aligned to the Firm’s strategy, client objectives and Markets growth priorities, while leveraging the Firm’s resources, balance sheet and thought leadership
Partner with Client Executives and sales and relationship management teams across Investment Services and Investment Management to promote Markets capabilities and solutions to deliver One State Street to APAC top GCD clients
Represent Markets at industry conferences and State Street led symposiums with a focus on promoting the Markets brand which includes a holistic set of liquidity, financing, and research solutions
Promote Markets innovative award-winning product, platform and thought leadership internally and externally to acquire new and deepen existing client relationships
Champion a client-led, collaborative culture across the region, reinforcing consistent messaging, shared accountability, and a disciplined focus on commercial outcomes.

These skills will help you succeed in this role
Deep understanding of capital markets and the needs of institutional investors, with experience across one or more Markets businesses such as foreign exchange, financing, securities lending, or research and advisory solutions.
Strong commercial judgment and the ability to connect client priorities, product capabilities, relationship dynamics, and firm economics.
Executive presence and credibility with senior clients and internal leaders, including the ability to represent a broad franchise rather than a single product.
Proven ability to develop strategic client relationships, originate commercial dialogue, and translate engagement into concrete opportunities and accountable follow-through.
Ability to influence across a highly matrixed, global organization and align stakeholders with different product, regional, and functional priorities.
Strong understanding of APAC institutional markets, regional client segments, and the importance of adapting global strategies to local market context.
Excellent communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to articulate complex Markets capabilities as a clear, client-relevant proposition.
Analytical mindset and comfort using client, revenue, product, and activity data to guide prioritization and commercial decision making.
Collaborative leadership style with the ability to build trust across Sales, Product, Relationship Management, and senior business leadership.
Ability to balance strategic perspective with practical execution, operating discipline, and attention to detail.

Minimum of 15 years of experience in capital markets, institutional sales, client coverage, relationship management, commercial strategy, business development, or related roles.
Demonstrated success leading complex client relationships or regional commercial initiatives within a global financial institution, investment bank, asset manager, securities services organization, or market infrastructure provider.
Strong knowledge of institutional client needs and buying dynamics across asset managers, asset owners, financial institutions, official institutions, or other relevant client segments.
Experience working across multiple Markets products and coordinating integrated solutions across product and organizational boundaries.
Established network and credibility within APAC institutional markets, with the ability to engage effectively across different countries, cultures, and seniority levels.
Proven track record of influencing senior stakeholders, mobilizing cross-functional teams, and advancing opportunities without relying solely on direct authority.
Experience using CRM, account planning, pipeline management, client analytics, or related commercial tools to improve focus and accountability.
Bachelor's degree required; MBA, CFA, or other relevant advanced degree or professional qualification preferred.
Additional Requirements
Ability to travel regularly across APAC and, as required, to other global locations.
Ability to operate effectively across time zones in a global, highly matrixed organization.
Ability to build credibility quickly with senior clients, business leaders, and product specialists while driving alignment across competing priorities.
Ability to manage ambiguity, exercise sound judgment, and lead complex client and commercial initiatives from strategy through execution.

Author incident status updates and closure reports to leadership.
Produce postmortem reports to identify lessons learned and recommendations.
Continuously prepare for incidents by updating and maintaining incident response plans, playbooks and procedures.
Manage and participate in cyber related exercises such as tabletops and cyber ranges.
Measure the effectiveness and performance of the incident response process through KRI and KPI metrics.
Identify methods to continuously enhance the incident response process
Work closely with the SOC to drive development and collaboration
Train and Mentor SOC personnel
Creating an environment which drives knowledge sharing with teams across the Fusion Center
Help developing the Fusion Center mindset and follow the sun model

Experience working/leading in a SOC or Fusion Center
Strong operating systems administration skills (Windows, Linux, Mac)
Strong malware analysis expertise
Experience in performing memory forensics
Knowledge of adversarial tactics, techniques, procedures (TTPs) & Industry standard frameworks (NIST, Mitre Att&ck)
Knowledge of IT architecture and operations (computing, network, storage & cloud)
Strong working knowledge of security technologies including but not limited to SIEM, EDR/EPP, AV, ID/PS, HIPS, Web Proxy/Content filtering, AD, PKI and DNS
Master's in cyber security, Information Technology, Computer Science or relevant experience

The Business Solutions Specialist plays an integral role in the ongoing relationship management of existing clients to educate clients and prospects in the use, features and benefits of the Charles River Investment Management Solution & Alpha Data Platform (collectively the Alpha Platform) across multiple Asset Classes within Asian Pacific Markets.

Liaison between market participants, existing clients, internal stakeholders.
Close interaction with Charles River Relationship Management and Sales team to drive forward end-client adoption of our solutions and drive new opportunities.
Forge relationships with Charles River clients through business and social contact.
Travel to clients and prospective clients across Asia Pacific.
To quickly become familiar with developments of and enhancements to CR IMS and Alpha Data Platform.
Informal training of Charles River Sales team, Relationship Management team, implementation staff and clients in the product.
Assist with RFPs and POCs

25% Organise and run client engagements and detailed workshops with business units and end users
25% preparation and detailed product presentation and demonstration to highly sophisticated investment professionals
25% follow-up with clients & prospects to close out any unanswered questions or objections.
10% assist with RFPs or request for information preparation.
10% self training on product featurs and training of internal teams on how clients are using the system.
5% represent CRD at conferences and Industry trade show events.
What We Value
These skills will help you succeed in this role
An understanding of investment markets from a front and/or middle office perspective and what each user persona requires to be effective.
Must have technical acumen to understand requirements and objections and be able to articulate and demonstrate CRD advantages.
Excellent organisation skills; ability to manage multiple complex tasks simultaneously and meet self-imposed deadlines in a dynamic environment.
Foster relationships with senior market practitioners in large and small corporations.
Superior oral and written communication and interpersonal skills.
Able to differentiate and work at strategic and tactical levels simultaneously.
Consultative presentation style to diverse and complex audiences
High degree of proficiency in navigating front and middle office investment applications
Language skills – Mandarin, Cantonese, Korean, Japanese or Thai would also be an advantage, but not mandatory.

Experience in the financial markets industry is mandatory.

Bachelors Degree from a leading university in Business Management, Economics, Finance, Computer Science

State Street is seeking a Cryptographic Key Management Operations Engineer to support the end-to-end lifecycle management of cryptographic keys across cloud, on-premises, infrastructure, and IoT environments.
